import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

P = data[0]
Q = int(data[1])
queries = [(data[2 + 4 * i], data[3 + 4 * i], int(data[4 + 4 * i]), int(data[5 + 4 * i])) for i in range(Q)]

n = len(P)
prefix_count = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(4)]
for i, char in enumerate(P):
    for j in range(4):
        prefix_count[j][i + 1] = prefix_count[j][i]
    prefix_count[ord(char) - ord('c')][i + 1] += 1

results = []
for a, b, L, R in queries:
    start_count = prefix_count[ord(a) - ord('c')][L - 1]
    end_count = prefix_count[ord(b) - ord('c')][R]
    total_count = prefix_count[ord(b) - ord('c')][R] - prefix_count[ord(b) - ord('c')][L - 1]
    good_strings = total_count - (start_count * (end_count - start_count))
    results.append(good_strings)

for result in results:
    print(result)
